Title: Public preview of Azure Database for MySQL – Flexible Server now offers reserved instance pricing

Body.Content:
Azure Database for MySQL - Flexible Server can now help you save money by prepaying for compute resources compared to pay-as-you-go pricing. With Azure Database for MySQL – Flexible Server reserved capacity, you can make an upfront commitment on MySQL server for a one- or three-year period to get a significant discount on the compute costs. To purchase Azure Database for MySQL – Flexible Server reserved capacity, you simply need to specify the Azure region, deployment type, performance tier, and term.

Learn more.
